info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Banking Security Advisory API
info.description: The Banking Security Advisory API allows businesses to update their security advisory information in a dynamic banking environment. By utilizing the PATCH method, clients can modify specific aspects of their existing security advisories, ensuring they remain compliant and effectively address current security threats. This API is particularly useful for financial institutions seeking to enhance their security postures and communicate updates to their stakeholders. Typical consumers include banking software developers and enterprise risk management teams aiming for better security management practices.
